const m = /^Bearer\s+(.+)$/i.exec(($json.headers || {}).authorization || '');
return [{ json: m ? { token: m[1].trim() } : { error: { status: 401, detail: 'Missing token' } } }];

parameters.query: select coalesce((select to_jsonb(p) from (select role, full_name from profiles where id = $1::uuid) p), '{}'::jsonb) as profile

with cl as (select id from clients where slug = $1),
ok as (select $3::text in ('admin', 'media_buyer') as can),
b as (select r.* from recommendations r where r.id = $2::bigint and r.client_id = (select id from cl) and (select can from ok)),
upd as (
  update recommendations set status = 'dismissed',
         verification = coalesce(verification, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('dismissed_by', $4::text)
  where id = $2::bigint and client_id = (select id from cl) and status in ('proposed', 'approved') and (select can from ok)
  returning *
),
a1 as (
insert into audit_log (actor_type, actor_id, actor_email, action, entity_type, entity_id,
                       client_id, before, after, request_id, ip, user_agent, environment)
select 'user', ($5::jsonb->>'actor_id')::uuid, $5::jsonb->>'actor_email', 'recommendation.dismiss', 'recommendation', $2::text,
       (select id from cl), (select to_jsonb(b) from b), to_jsonb(upd), null, ($5::jsonb->>'ip')::inet, $5::jsonb->>'user_agent', 'production'
from upd)
select json_build_object(
  'client', exists (select 1 from cl), 'can', (select can from ok), 'found', exists (select 1 from b),
  'row', (select to_json(upd) from upd)) as data
